info.title: rowboat-api
info.description: Entity-shaped REST surface generated from ent schemas. Streaming/proxy endpoints are hand-curated and merged.

get.description: List CreditLedgers.

parameters.name: itemsPerPage
parameters.description: item count to render per page

post.description: Creates a new CreditLedger and persists it to storage.

get.description: Finds the CreditLedger with the requested ID and returns it.

200.description: CreditLedger with requested ID was found

delete.description: Deletes the CreditLedger with the requested ID.

204.description: CreditLedger with requested ID was deleted

patch.description: Updates a CreditLedger and persists changes to storage.

get.description: Find the attached User of the CreditLedger with the given ID

200.description: User attached to CreditLedger with requested ID was found
